purpose: Form DPT-3 is used by companies to file a return of deposit or particulars of transactions not considered as deposit or both. It is also used to file details of monies accepted from members by a specified IFSC public company or a private company.
who: Every company to which these rules apply (other than Government company for certain specific returns).
when: On or before the 30th day of June of every year (or within ninety days from 31st March, 2019 for the specific one-time return under Rule 16A(3)).
steps: Gather the required information and particulars as on the 31st day of March of that year.
Ensure the information is duly audited by the auditor of the company.
Obtain the declaration from the auditor to be submitted in Form DPT-3.
File the return in Form DPT-3 with the Registrar along with the required fee.
checklist: Information contained as on the 31st day of March of that year
Audit of the information by the auditor of the company
Declaration by the auditor to be submitted in Form DPT-3
Fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014
watch: Every company must file the return on or before the 30th day of June of every year.
